messages:
mina: FYI onboarding call with EU cust bank tomorrow. They require BYOK using their on-prem CloudHSM and want strict operator separation + tamper-proof audit logs. What knobs do we need on our Private proxy?
carter: Main items: distinct RBAC roles, mandatory MFA + ephemeral creds for import ops, attestation verification, and write-once audit sinks (customer-controlled). infra folks must be scoped out of any key-launch/import perms.
rachel: Proposed roles: `hsm-importer` (can request import, must attach approval_ticket), `hsm-unwrapper` (performs unwrap with customer attestation), `hsm-auditor` (read-only audit access), `hsm-admin` (config/network only). No role should have both import & audit.
mina: For audit schema the bank asked for cryptographic evidence fields. Suggest event record include: timestamp, event_type, actor, role, request_id, key_fingerprint, wrap_pubkey_fingerprint, attestation_blob, attestation_verification_result, firmware_version, agent_binary_sha256, host_fingerprint, tenant_id, action_trace.
carter: Retention: EU regulated -> 7 years default but allow customer to request longer. Export note: any export must be encrypted with customer CMK and logged with signed manifest. Also include proof-of-possession chain for import events.
mina: Vulnerability triage note: if HSM agent CVE => immediate pause of import/unwrap operations, trigger rotation run (break-glass) and notify legal + compliance + customer. Collect: agent PID snapshot, loaded modules, firmware serial, attestation history.
rachel: Who owns rotation orchestration? Ops will run it for Private deployments but only after customer-provided attestation tokens and an approval ticket. We'll implement canary rotate + verification hooks (kv-cache invalidation, signer health checks). Customer must sign SLA clause that we may run rotations on their behalf when CVE/high-sev detected.
carter: Quick policy draft (minimal): ```json
{
  "Version":"2024-06-01",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":"role:hsm-importer","Action":["hsm:RequestImport"],"Resource":"arn:redwood:hsm:eu-1:tenant/*","Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent":"true"}}},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":"role:hsm-unwrapper","Action":["hsm:UnwrapWithAttestation"],"Resource":"arn:redwood:hsm:eu-1:tenant/*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"hsm:AttestationVerified":"true"}}}
  ]
}
```
mina: Nice. Add `IpAddress` condition for office jump boxes + require approval_ticket param.
security-bot: policy-diff: new role `hsm-unwrapper` grants `hsm:UnwrapWithAttestation`. Manual approval required from `sec-lead`. See https://redwood.internal/policy-diff/6770012345 :warning:
rachel: Ops items: add immutable audit sink (S3 with object-lock or write-only GCS), KMS envelope using customer CMK, incremental signed manifests per import, and a verification endpoint that returns signed attestations we can show the customer.
carter: Edge case: customer HSM may not produce attestation format we require. Need fallback: an HSM-attestation adapter step where customer provides a signed statement from their security team and we store it in evidence_bucket with manual acceptance flow. That should be rare.
mina: Next steps: carter files RBAC PR with policy JSON + tests; rachel drafts audit schema + retention table; i'll draft onboarding SLA blurb re: rotation authority and evidence chain. We have to turn this around before call.
carter: I'll also add a small test harness that simulates Wrap/Unwrap flow and records the attestation blob.
rachel: Tagging compliance/legal in the PR. Ping here when drafts are up.
mina: thanks :thumbsup:
